exposure: plans to return to work ≤2 months after delivery
cohort: Primiparous women, aged 18-35 years, living in Pennsylvania (n = 2,839)
finding: Paternal education level was independently associated with breastfeeding initiation and duration, with higher paternal education levels associated with increased likelihood of breastfeeding initiation and duration.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was considered as a covariate in the analysis of breastfeeding initiation and duration.
